why.raw stays append-only: an edited raw file destroys the only thing a rebuild can restore from; flipping `processed` is the one sanctioned edit, and deletion only under a declared retention obligation
why.usage/log.md row appended: the friction field is the whole improvement flywheel; a skill that skips it under pressure makes corp-os-improve blind
why.derived-layer writes have a proposal beh: a proposal that lives only in chat dies with the session and leaves no record of what the gate saw -- the declines especially, which are the only trace of what someone chose not to know
why.the run closed its own books: every failing conformance check in this suite has been the last step of a run
why.the teammate's pattern was not edited to: weakening a requirement to make a refusal go away produces an output that renders an empty panel, which reads as a state rather than a defect. Editing an adopted pattern also forks the pack silently, so the next update reports drift nobody chose
why.the refusal is reported rather than work: this OS has jobs disabled, so a job board genuinely cannot be built here. The right outcome is naming that, not rendering a board with an empty panel
